text: Good Friday at Holy Trinity Cathedral
Today is Good Friday – the most somber day of Holy Week. The Orthodox Church commemorates the crucifixion of Jesus Christ, the descent from the Cross, and His burial.
The Locum Tenens of the Patriarchal Throne, Metropolitan Shio, is officiating the Royal Hours, Vespers, and the bringing out of the Shroud (Epitaphios) at the Holy Trinity Patriarchal Cathedral.

On Good Friday, the Divine Liturgy is not celebrated in churches because, according to the Gospel, the Lord sacrificed Himself to redeem humanity from sins. During the service, the Royal Hours are performed, during which the Gospel concerning the Passion of the Lord is read.
